desc.so: Shaxda caalamiga ah: ka ciyaar kombiyuutarka ama saaxiib.
desc.en: Classic chess against the computer or a friend on the same device.

how.so: Taabo gabal, kadibna taabo meesha aad u dhaqaajineyso. Boqorka kan kale ku xir (checkmate) si aad u guuleysato.
how.en: Tap a piece, then tap where it should go. Checkmate the other king to win. Undo is allowed.

desc.so: Ciyaar shax-laadhuu ah: geli afartaada gabal gurigooda ka hor inta kuwa kale.
desc.en: A dice race board game: bring all four of your tokens home first. Play the computer or friends.

how.so: Riix laadhuuga, kadibna taabo gabal. 6 ayaa gabal ka saara saldhigga. Meelaha xiddigta leh waa ammaan.
how.en: Roll the dice, then tap a token to move. A 6 brings a token out. Star squares are safe.

desc.so: Isku xir dhagaxyada tirada isku mid ah. Ka hor mar kombiyuutarka.
desc.en: Match the ends of the tiles and empty your hand before the computer does.

how.so: Taabo dhagax ku habboon cidhif ka mid ah silsiladda. Haddii aadan haysan, mid soo qaado.
how.en: Tap a tile that matches an end of the chain. If you can’t play, draw a tile.

desc.so: Ku orod waddooyinka, ka bood caqabadaha oo uruuri lacagaha.
desc.en: Run through the city, jump and dodge obstacles and collect coins.

how.so: Bidix/midig si aad waddo u beddesho, kor si aad u booddo, hoos si aad u gunuuncato.
how.en: Left/right to switch lanes, up to jump, down to slide.

keys.so: Fallaadhaha ama W A S D. Mobile: gacanta mari ama riix badhamada.
keys.en: Arrow keys or W A S D. Phone: swipe or use the on-screen buttons.

desc.so: Baabuurtaada wad, iska ilaali gawaarida kale oo shidaal uruuri.
desc.en: Drive fast, avoid traffic and pick up fuel and coins.

how.so: Bidix iyo midig si aad u leexato. Kor si aad u dardargeliso, hoos si aad u yareyso.
how.en: Left/right to steer. Up to speed up, down to brake.

keys.so: Fallaadhaha ama W A S D. Mobile: gacanta mari ama riix badhamada.
keys.en: Arrow keys or W A S D. Phone: swipe or use the on-screen buttons.

desc.so: Laad rigoore oo ka hor tag laadadka kooxda kale.
desc.en: Take penalties and save shots in a five-round shootout.

how.so: Taabo meesha aad rabto inaad kubadda u dirto. Marka aad goolhaye tahay, taabo dhinaca aad u booddo.
how.en: Tap where you want to shoot. When you are the goalkeeper, tap where to dive.

desc.so: Ku tuur kubadda shabagga intaadan waqtigu dhammaan.
desc.en: Throw the ball into the hoop as many times as you can before time runs out.

how.so: Kubadda jiid oo sii daa si aad u tuurto. Inta aad jiiddo ayay xooggu le’eg yahay.
how.en: Drag the ball back and release to throw. A longer drag is a stronger throw.

desc.so: Mas yar oo cunaya miro oo sii dheeraanaya. Ha isku dhicin!
desc.en: Guide the snake to the fruit and grow longer. Don’t bite your tail!

how.so: Fallaadhaha ama gacanta mari si aad jihada u beddesho.
how.en: Use the arrows or swipe to turn.

keys.so: Fallaadhaha ama W A S D. Mobile: gacanta mari ama riix badhamada.
keys.en: Arrow keys or W A S D. Phone: swipe or use the on-screen buttons.

desc.so: Isku dhig dhagxaanta dhacaya si aad saf buuxa u tirtirto.
desc.en: Fit the falling blocks together to clear full lines.

how.so: Bidix/midig dhaqaaji, kor wareeji, hoos dhaqso u soo deji, Space si toos ah u dhig.
how.en: Left/right to move, up to rotate, down to drop faster, Space for a hard drop.

keys.so: Fallaadhaha ama W A S D. Mobile: gacanta mari ama riix badhamada.
keys.en: Arrow keys or W A S D. Phone: swipe or use the on-screen buttons.

desc.so: Isku dar tirooyinka isku midka ah ilaa aad gaarto 2048.
desc.en: Slide the tiles and merge equal numbers to reach 2048.

how.so: Fallaadhaha ama gacanta mari si dhammaan tirooyinka loo dhaqaajiyo.
how.en: Use the arrows or swipe to slide all the tiles.

keys.so: Fallaadhaha ama W A S D. Mobile: gacanta mari ama riix badhamada.
keys.en: Arrow keys or W A S D. Phone: swipe or use the on-screen buttons.

desc.so: Ciyaarta kaararka ee caanka ah: kala hagaaji afarta nooc.
desc.en: The classic patience card game: build the four suits from Ace to King.

how.so: Taabo kaar, kadibna taabo meesha aad dhigayso. Laba jeer taabo si toos ah ugu dirto saldhigga.
how.en: Tap a card, then tap where to put it. Double-tap to send it to the foundations.

desc.so: Buuxi shaxda si saf kasta, tiir kasta iyo sanduuq kasta uu 1 ilaa 9 u yeesho.
desc.en: Fill the grid so every row, column and box has 1 to 9.

how.so: Taabo god, kadibna taabo tiro. Qalinka u isticmaal qoraallo.
how.en: Tap a square, then a number. Use the pencil for notes.

desc.so: Dhis guryo, beero iyo magaalooyin adiga oo isticmaalaya dhagxaan midab leh.
desc.en: Build houses, gardens and towns with colourful blocks. Your world is saved.

how.so: Dooro dhagax, kadibna taabo shaxda si aad u dhigto. Masaxa u isticmaal inaad tirtirto.
how.en: Choose a block and tap the grid to place it. Use the eraser to remove.

desc.so: Ku bood gabalada kale oo ka qaad dhammaan.
desc.en: Jump over your opponent’s pieces and capture them all.

how.so: Taabo gabal, kadibna meesha uu u socdo. Haddii aad qaadi karto, waa qasab.
how.en: Tap a piece, then where it goes. If you can capture, you must.

desc.so: Ku dhig afar gabal oo isku xiga saf, tiir ama xagal.
desc.en: Drop discs and get four in a row before your opponent.

how.so: Taabo tiir si aad gabal ugu ridato.
how.en: Tap a column to drop a disc.

desc.so: Su’aalo ku saabsan Soomaaliya, adduunka, sayniska iyo cayaaraha.
desc.en: Questions about Somalia, the world, science and sport.

how.so: Dooro jawaabta saxda ah intaanu waqtigu dhammaan. 50:50 waxay ka saartaa laba jawaab.
how.en: Choose the right answer before the timer runs out. 50:50 removes two answers.

desc.so: Xisaab degdeg ah, midabada, tirada weyn iyo waxa ka duwan.
desc.en: Quick maths, colours, bigger number and odd-one-out challenges.

how.so: Si degdeg ah u jawaab. Jawaab kasta oo sax ah waxay ku siinaysaa dhibco iyo waqti.
how.en: Answer fast. Every correct answer gives points and extra time.

desc.so: Intee in le’eg ayaad u dhaqso badan tahay? Tijaabi falcelintaada.
desc.en: How fast are you? Test your reactions with lights and targets.

how.so: Sug ilaa uu cagaar noqdo, kadibna taabo. Kadib taabo bartilmaameedyada.
how.en: Wait for green, then tap. Then tap the targets as fast as you can.

desc.so: Baabuurka si taxaddar leh u geli meesha la dhigto.
desc.en: Steer carefully into the parking space without hitting anything.

how.so: Kor/hoos hore iyo gadaal, bidix/midig si aad u leexiso.
how.en: Up/down to drive forwards and backwards, left/right to steer.

keys.so: Fallaadhaha ama W A S D. Mobile: gacanta mari ama riix badhamada.
keys.en: Arrow keys or W A S D. Phone: swipe or use the on-screen buttons.

desc.so: Raadi furaha, fur albaabka oo ka bax dhexda. Uruuri xiddigaha!
desc.en: Find the key, open the door and escape the maze. Collect the stars!

how.so: Fallaadhaha ama gacanta mari si aad u socoto.
how.en: Use the arrows or swipe to move.

keys.so: Fallaadhaha ama W A S D. Mobile: gacanta mari ama riix badhamada.
keys.en: Arrow keys or W A S D. Phone: swipe or use the on-screen buttons.

desc.so: Raadi erayada ku qarsoon shaxda xarfaha.
desc.en: Find the hidden words in the letter grid.

how.so: Taabo xarafka hore, kadibna xarafka ugu dambeeya ee erayga.
how.en: Tap the first letter, then the last letter of the word.

desc.so: Buuxi erayada adiga oo raacaya tilmaamaha.
desc.en: Fill in the words using the clues.

how.so: Taabo god, qor xarfaha. Taabo mar kale si aad jihada u beddesho.
how.en: Tap a square and type. Tap again to change direction.

desc.so: Ciyaar dhagxaan Shiinees u eg: ka saar laba dhagax oo isku mid ah oo xor ah.
desc.en: A mahjong-style puzzle: remove pairs of matching free tiles to clear the board.

how.so: Taabo laba dhagax oo isku mid ah oo aan la xirin. Talo iyo isku-qas waa la heli karaa.
how.en: Tap two matching tiles that are free. Hints and shuffles are available.

desc.so: Rogo kaararka oo raadi labada isku midka ah.
desc.en: Turn over cards and find the matching pairs.

how.so: Taabo laba kaar. Haddii ay isku mid yihiin way furnaanayaan.
how.en: Tap two cards. If they match, they stay open.

desc.so: Dhaqaaji dhagxaanta si tirooyinku u noqdaan 1 ilaa dhammaad.
desc.en: Slide the tiles to put the numbers in order.

how.so: Taabo dhagax ku xiga meesha bannaan si aad u dhaqaajiso.
how.en: Tap a tile next to the gap to slide it.

keys.so: Fallaadhaha ama W A S D. Mobile: gacanta mari ama riix badhamada.
keys.en: Arrow keys or W A S D. Phone: swipe or use the on-screen buttons.

desc.so: Raadi labada xayawaan ee isku midka ah.
desc.en: Find the matching animal pairs.

how.so: Taabo laba kaar. Haddii ay isku mid yihiin way furnaanayaan.
how.en: Tap two cards. If they match, they stay open.

desc.so: Maqal xarafka oo dooro kan saxda ah.
desc.en: Listen to the letter and pick the right one.

how.so: Dhegeyso, kadibna taabo xarafka saxda ah. 🔊 ku riix si aad mar kale u maqasho.
how.en: Listen, then tap the right letter. Press 🔊 to hear it again.

desc.so: Tiri waxyaabaha oo dooro tirada saxda ah.
desc.en: Count the things and pick the right number.

how.so: Tiri sawirada, kadibna taabo tirada.
how.en: Count the pictures, then tap the number.

desc.so: Isku dar iyo ka jar fudud oo sawirro leh.
desc.en: Simple adding and taking away with pictures.

how.so: Xalli xisaabta, kadibna taabo jawaabta.
how.en: Work out the sum, then tap the answer.

desc.so: Eeg sawirka oo dooro erayga saxda ah.
desc.en: Look at the picture and choose the right word.

how.so: Taabo erayga ku habboon sawirka.
how.en: Tap the word that matches the picture.

desc.so: Xarfaha u kala hagaaji si aad u qorto erayga sawirka.
desc.en: Put the letters in order to spell the picture’s word.

how.so: Taabo xarfaha siday u kala horreeyaan. ↶ ayaa xarafkii u dambeeyay ka noqda.
how.en: Tap the letters in the right order. ↶ takes back the last letter.

desc.so: Midabee sawiro qurux badan: guri, kalluun, ubax, geel iyo kuwo kale.
desc.en: Colour in lovely pictures: a house, a fish, a flower, a camel and more.

how.so: Dooro midab, kadibna taabo qayb ka mid ah sawirka.
how.en: Pick a colour, then tap a part of the picture.

desc.so: Sawir wax kasta oo aad rabto: qalimo, midabo iyo stikarro.
desc.en: Draw anything you like with brushes, colours and stickers.

how.so: Farta ama jiirka ku sawir. Dooro midab, cabbir ama stikar. 💾 ayaa kaydisa sawirka.
how.en: Draw with your finger or mouse. Choose a colour, size or sticker. 💾 saves your drawing.

desc.so: Dhaqaaji qaybaha si sawirku u noqdo mid dhammaystiran.
desc.en: Slide the pieces to put the picture back together.

how.so: Taabo qayb ku xigta meesha bannaan.
how.en: Tap a piece next to the gap.

keys.so: Fallaadhaha ama W A S D. Mobile: gacanta mari ama riix badhamada.
keys.en: Arrow keys or W A S D. Phone: swipe or use the on-screen buttons.

desc.so: Isku xir xayawaanka iyo magaciisa.
desc.en: Match each animal with its name.

how.so: Taabo sawir, kadibna taabo magaciisa.
how.en: Tap a picture, then tap its name.

desc.so: Xayawaan kasta u geey meesha uu ku nool yahay.
desc.en: Match each animal with the place where it lives.

how.so: Taabo xayawaan, kadibna taabo gurigiisa.
how.en: Tap an animal, then tap its home.

desc.so: Qaab kasta geli meeshiisa saxda ah.
desc.en: Put each shape into its matching outline.

how.so: Jiid qaabka ilaa meeshiisa, ama taabo qaabka kadibna meesha.
how.en: Drag a shape to its outline, or tap the shape and then the outline.

desc.so: Dirxiga u geey miraha. Waa tartiib oo derbiyo ma laha.
desc.en: Lead the caterpillar to the fruit. It goes slowly and there are no walls.

how.so: Fallaadhaha ama gacanta mari.
how.en: Use the arrows or swipe.

keys.so: Fallaadhaha ama W A S D. Mobile: gacanta mari ama riix badhamada.
keys.en: Arrow keys or W A S D. Phone: swipe or use the on-screen buttons.
